about: What Anthropic reported for whole reads (#1554) with Claude Haiku 5.5, on the direct route, core only: a made-up Markdown lease of 60 parts of about 500 words and a rent clause, which the app reads as 61 sections (made again in tests/core/wholeReadCost.test.ts), read in two windows, the rent clause last. Each sentence was read twice on 2026-10-30, when each search of a window still returned the whole window (windowOnce false), and twice on 2026-10-31, once each window reached the model once (windowOnce true). Two more were read on 2026-10-31 after the price tiers: the rent sentence with its parts sorted first by a check of the Note (sorted), and the break clause unsorted. absence: the sentence says something is absent. Input counts all input tokens; usd is the tokens at the catalog's price, meteredUsd what the app's meter recorded with the prompt cache.
